business_problem: Endava needed to remain relevant in an AI-centric market by redesigning software delivery and cross-functional workflows, not just adding point tools to existing engineering processes.
solution_summary: Endava made OpenAI its enterprise AI platform and rebuilt delivery around agentic workflows rather than limiting AI to coding assistance. The transformation started in software-delivery teams, where developers using ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex discovered that faster engineering exposed new bottlenecks in requirements gathering, planning, business analysis, and stakeholder coordination. That led to DavaFlow, Endava’s AI-native delivery methodology, which applies OpenAI technology across the full lifecycle from meeting preparation and business planning to discovery, software engineering, deployment, and operational coordination. The rollout then expanded into legal, project management, finance, operations, and commercial teams, where Codex helps create governance reports, summarize engineering progress, and even replace spreadsheet-heavy planning with lightweight interactive applications. Leadership teams also use always-on agents for project summaries, communications, and inbox coordination, making AI fluency part of daily work and career expectations across an 11,000-person workforce.

solution_components.name: AI agents

data_flow: Meeting context, requirements, business plans, project updates, and engineering tasks move through DavaFlow into ChatGPT Enterprise, Codex, and background agents. Outputs become software artifacts, governance reports, planning apps, or summaries that teams across Endava review and use in client delivery.
business_outcome: Endava accelerated software delivery, reduced manual coordination work, spread AI usage beyond engineering, and established AI fluency as an expected behavior across hiring, leadership, and promotion decisions.
metrics: Expanded AI adoption beyond engineering into legal, finance, and operations teams
